semantic_units.term: traditional methods for naming salts of organic bases

methods.preferred_name_condition: the acid components of the adducts are organic compounds

methods.method: unaltered base followed by the name of the anion
unaltered base followed by a hydrohalide name

source_text: The names of these adducts are preferred IUPAC names only when the acid components of the adducts are organic compounds;
(2) the unaltered name of the base followed by the name of the anion;
(3) for salts of hydrohalogen acids only, the unaltered name of the base is followed by hydrofluoride, hydrobromide, hydrochloride, or hydroiodide, as the case may be.

symbol_declarations.description: Construct a preferred binary salt name by citing the cation name followed by the anion name.
Derive the preferred IUPAC name of an organic monosalt by substitutive nomenclature.
